F-actin_nonlinear.reference_semantics: BioSR repository owner states SIM_gt_a.mrc was used to train the network; SIM_gt_b.mrc is a gamma-0.6 overview image. Only a is claim eligible.

spectral_analysis.pair_rule: Apply identical physical frequency limits to input and reference. Spectral orientation is diagnostic only in v7.

tensor_orientation_distribution.interpretation: A complete axial orientation distribution remains defined for crossing, multimodal and near-isotropic structure; no scalar dominant-axis claim is made.

coherence_only_resolution_margin.operation: Gaussian blur on robustly normalized input before physical tensor measurement
coherence_only_resolution_margin.selection_origin: Most permissive observed development boundary satisfying the declared risk, coverage and comparator rules; therefore all development benefit estimates are descriptive and independent confirmation is mandatory.

support_contract.family_specific_rule: The strong resolution-margin component governs tensor coherence only. It is calculated and retained as a diagnostic for the orientation distribution but cannot alter orientation-distribution acceptance.

confirmation.field_selection_rule: For each structure, sort all central-directory Cell_### identifiers by sha256('NOSTOS-v7-initial-confirmation|' + structure + '|' + reference_group_id), where reference_group_id is structure + '|' + Cell_###, and select the first eight. The lock records the selected cells before any image-member byte is opened for v7.

separate_incremental_coherence_utility_r.not_assessable_rule: If conventional acquisition QC emits no invalid coherence case, incremental utility is not assessable and no superiority claim may be made. Measurement safety is decided separately.

comparators.conventional_acquisition_qc: The identical estimator governed only by acquisition-QC hard failures and its continuous acquisition-QC score.
comparators.always_emit: The identical estimator emitting every registration- and reference-eligible measurement.
comparators.comparison_scope: Incremental contract utility is tested only for tensor coherence because the strong resolution-margin component is diagnostic-only for orientation distributions.

access_boundary: Archives were downloaded and integrity verified before v7. Central-directory filenames and sizes were inspected to repair the v6 layout mismatch. No F-actin pixel array or v7 endpoint outcome was decoded before the v7 implementation, configuration, selected field identifiers and lock were frozen.
claim_boundary: Paired-acquisition safety and, only if independently confirmed, incremental coherence support relative to registered high-SNR BioSR reconstructions. Not image restoration, biological phenotype inference, diagnosis, clinical validity, diffraction-limit estimation, or proof that the reference reconstruction is ground-truth biology.
